corrections.before: C/E*Y*d*m*x*network gives an expected additional unique risk-person cohort, capped at judgment K: N=min(...,K). From donation time until delay L both arms have hazard h=lambda+mu. During min(tau,T-L) the intervention reduces only opioid fatal hazard by lambda*e; afterward both arms have postLambda+postMu. Integrate u*(S_with-S_without)*exp(-r*t) over [0,T], then subtract harmPerProtected per N and independentHarm per gift. Q_CA=g*Q_all; price_10_CA=10*C/Q_CA only if Q_CA>0. Closed form: H=max(0,T-L),b=min(tau,H),A(k,z)=-expm1(-k*z)/k; q=u*exp(-(h+r)*L)*[A(h-lambda*e+r,b)-A(h+r,b)+exp(-h*b)*expm1(lambda*e*b)*exp(-r*b)*A(postLambda+postMu+r,H-b)]. Q_all=N*(q-harmPerProtected)-independentHarm. Delayed protection is discounted and survives baseline risk before delivery; no repeated-lifetime awards.
corrections.after: C/E*Y*d*m*x*network gives an expected additional unique risk-person cohort, capped at judgment K: N=min(...,K). From donation time until delay L both arms have hazard h=lambda+mu. During min(tau,T-L) the intervention reduces only opioid fatal hazard by lambda*e; afterward both arms have postLambda+postMu. Integrate u*(S_with-S_without)*exp(-r*t) over [0,T], then subtract harmPerProtected per N and independentHarm per gift. Q_CA=g*Q_all; scenario cost=C+extraResources; price_10_CA=10*(C+extraResources)/Q_CA only if Q_CA>0.
